scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:verification && pnpm --recursive --filter '!portcullis-workspace' run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:verification && pnpm --recursive --filter '!portcullis-workspace' run lint
scripts.test: pnpm run test:verification && pnpm --recursive --filter '!portcullis-workspace' run test
scripts.test:verification: pnpm run typecheck:verification && pnpm run lint:verification && node --test tests/verification/*.test.ts
